notes: Pygame desktop chess (CabreChess) with own minimax AI, clocks, PGN. GPL-3.0-or-later whole-repo. Audio synthesized in-memory (no third-party SFX). Chess pieces: cburnett set (CC0 / public domain by Colin M.L. Burnett; Lichess redistrib). UI uses pygame SysFont only (no bundled TTF). No LFS. Snapshot ~1.5M. Claim issue #1397.
